{07 14 00}I'm wearing the lovely
{0b 02 00}{04 1b 00} you

{07 14 00}I got your letter, and it
made me so happy. I love
getting mail!
But then, I opened it up
and saw that incredible
{07 0a 00}{0b 02 00}{04 1b 00}!
You really shouldn't have.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}But I'm so glad you did! It
fits perfectly, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Heya{01 07 00},
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}.

{07 17 00}Did you notice I'm wearing
the {0b 02 00}{04 1b 00}
you sent me?
{07 14 00}I don't mean to sound vain,
but{01 00 00 05 00} I look fabulous in it,
don't I, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

truth. I won't let it go to
my head.
